text: Figure 7.2: Physical channel view definition example A The CanIf supports multiple physical CAN channels. These have to be distinguished by the CanSm for network control. The CanIf API provides request and read control for multiple underlying physical CAN channels. Moreover the CanIf does not distinguish between dedicated types of CAN physical layers (i.e. Low-Speed CAN or High-Speed CAN ), to which one or multiple CAN Controllers are connected.
